section_hints.intro: Broad framing, narrative tone, hedge terms preferred.
section_hints.methods: Passive voice required; precise method statements; past tense.
section_hints.findings: Neutral, measurement-driven; no speculation; concrete numerical values.
section_hints.discussion: Interpretive yet balanced; 'it can be argued', 'this suggests' style hedging.

llm_prompt_template: Rewrite the following sentences in academic English. Rules: (1) avoid absolute terms ('always', 'never'), use hedging; (2) prefer passive voice constructions; (3) third-person, formal register; (4) MEANING MUST NOT CHANGE — only style. {section_hint} {user_style_note}
